pages.title: Auto Repair
pages.text: §lMax Level:§r III$(br2)§lApplicable to:§r All items with durability$(br2)§lEffect:§r Enchanted items in your equipment slots repair themselves every 5 seconds: 1-3 durability at level I, 5-7 at level II, 10-12 at level III.$(br2)§lConflicts:§r None$(br2)§lObtained via:§r Loot chests (treasure enchantment)
